sketches.mechanism: Move semantics: a non-Copy value is consumed when passed by value, and any later use is rejected at compile time.
sketches.resonance: What has been given away cannot be offered again; the compiler preserves the shape of loss.

sketches.mechanism: Range-constrained subtypes raise Constraint_Error when assigned a value outside their declared bounds.
sketches.resonance: The hand can hold only what its shape permits, and excess becomes an exception rather than a possession.

sketches.mechanism: defer statements run automatically at scope exit in last-in, first-out order.
sketches.resonance: At the end, promises are kept backward, so the first thing delayed is the last trace remaining.
